# Sprint NN Outcome

Window: dates. Status: Planned/Active/Closed. Goal: one observable outcome.
Capacity: relative points, evidence for estimate and rework reserve.

## Selected stories

Ordered IDs/links, points, dependencies and why each supports the goal.
Backlog owns status. Refine Backlog into Ready before implementation.

## Tasks

Per story: grounding/spec, implementation, failure tests, review and verification.
Use checkboxes; keep acceptance in the backlog instead of duplicating it.

## Closeout

Demo, accepted/carried work, review/retrospective link, metrics delta and next-sprint
proposal. Update current-sprint links. No scope expansion beyond user authority.
